name: Barbell Bench Press
blurb: Lower the bar to mid-chest under control, press to lockout; shoulder blades pinned.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
blurb: Press from shoulder height on a 30° incline, biasing upper chest.

name: Cable Fly
blurb: Sweep hands together in a wide arc, squeeze at the midpoint.

name: Weighted Dip
blurb: Lean forward, lower until shoulders dip below elbows, press up.

name: Pull-Up
blurb: Overhand grip, chin over bar, elbows driven toward hips.

name: Lat Pulldown
blurb: Pull to upper chest with tall torso; control the stretch on the return.

name: Barbell Row
blurb: Hinge to ~45°, row into the lower ribs without heaving.

name: Seated Cable Row
blurb: Pull to the waist with neutral spine; let the blades glide.

name: T-Bar Row
blurb: Chest-braced angle row; drive elbows back, squeeze mid-back.

name: Overhead Press
blurb: Press from shoulders to lockout; glutes tight, no lean-back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
blurb: Raise to shoulder height with soft elbows; slow three-count down.

name: Rear Delt Fly
blurb: Hinge and sweep wide, leading with the elbows.

name: Arnold Press
blurb: Rotate palms-in to palms-forward while pressing overhead.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
blurb: Press dumbbells overhead from a supported seat.

name: Barbell Shrug
blurb: Shrug straight up toward the ears; pause a full second.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
blurb: Controlled squeeze at the top; no rolling.

name: Face Pull
blurb: Rope to eye level, elbows high, finish with external rotation.

name: Chest-Supported Row
blurb: Row on an incline pad; strict upper-back squeeze, zero momentum.

name: Cable Pushdown
blurb: Elbows pinned, extend to full lockout, controlled return.

name: Skull Crusher
blurb: Lower to just above the forehead, elbows up, extend back.

name: Overhead Cable Extension
blurb: Extend overhead from a deep stretch for the long head.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
blurb: Shoulder-width grip, elbows tucked, load on the triceps.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
blurb: One arm at a time; strict elbow position, full extension.

name: Barbell Curl
blurb: Elbows pinned, zero swing, slow negative.

name: Dumbbell Curl
blurb: Alternate or together; full supination at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
blurb: Curl from a fully stretched position on an incline bench.

name: Hammer Curl
blurb: Neutral grip; hits brachialis and forearms.

name: Preacher Curl
blurb: Arms braced on the pad; no cheating at the bottom.

name: Reverse Curl
blurb: Overhand grip curl; forearms and brachioradialis do the work.

name: Wrist Curl
blurb: Forearms on a bench, curl the wrist through a full arc.

name: Farmer's Carry
blurb: Heavy dumbbells, tall posture, walk until grip fails.

name: Back Squat
blurb: Sit down between the hips, drive up through mid-foot.

name: Leg Press
blurb: Deep controlled reps; knees track over toes.

name: Hack Squat
blurb: Machine-braced squat; constant quad tension.

name: Pendulum Squat
blurb: Arc-path machine squat; deep knee flexion, minimal spine load.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
blurb: Rear foot elevated; drop straight down, drive through the front heel.

name: Leg Extension
blurb: Squeeze to full lockout; slow lowering.

name: Romanian Deadlift
blurb: Push the hips back, bar close, stretch the hamstrings, stand tall.

name: Lying Leg Curl
blurb: Curl to full contraction; don't let the hips rise.

name: Seated Leg Curl
blurb: Long-length curl; pad locked over the thighs.

name: Good Morning
blurb: Bar on the back, hinge until you feel the stretch, stand up.

name: Standing Calf Raise
blurb: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

name: Seated Calf Raise
blurb: Bent-knee raise biasing the soleus; slow tempo.

name: Cable Crunch
blurb: Kneel and crunch the ribs toward the hips; spine flexion, not hip hinge.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
blurb: Raise legs with posterior pelvic tilt; no swinging.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
blurb: Roll out as far as bracing allows; ribs down the whole way.

name: Weighted Plank
blurb: Plate on the back; rigid line from head to heels.
